e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded student 小红 (balance 0), whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: Rejection behavior: 小红 (balance 0) cannot select course 8 (price 74). The expected delta is intentionally EMPTY — no row may change; the assertion lives in the DOM. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
